violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to apply for a RICFSM with RIDOH. Application was printed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils can opener, bar ice machine, and kitchen ice machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener was moved to 3-bay sink, and both ice machine were put out of order and emptied at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to use either ice machine until they are properly cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the main entrance, and upstairs by stairwell are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The 2 door reach-in, chest freezer, and prep unit was observed non-operational and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the bar. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
Establishment is lacking proper drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the 2 door reach-in have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The outside dumpster area was observed with an accumulation of debris. Outside refuse areas must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The wall in the front service area by the entry way was observed with a hole and is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the upstairs storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The floor under the 2 door reach-in area, and behind the ice machine has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The floor under the soda area has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings using appropriate means of sanitization to monitor for new activity. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the front entrance area, observed not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025

The cutting boards in the back kitchen area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025
